dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product has places that sometimes hold nothing — a search that found nothing, a list nobody has added to yet, a table whose filter matches no row, a page that waits for its first project — and says so in the place itself, in the same manner everywhere: what is missing, in a few words; why, or what to do about it; and, where there is something to do, the control that does it. It says it small inside a list or a panel and large where the empty place is the whole page.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything an empty state reads: per size, the room above and below it, the glyph's box and the text styles of its title and its description; the room at its sides; the longest line of its text; the glyph's color and the space under it; the title's color and the space under it; the description's color; the space above the actions and between two of them.
rules: An empty state stands where content would be and there is none: it replaces the list, the rows, the results. A notice beside content that is there is a callout; a message about something that just happened is a snackbar.
Say what is missing in the title, in plain words ("No results for tokne", "No projects yet"). Say why, or what to do, in the description. Offer at most two actions, the main one first.
It is quiet: no fill, no edge, secondary colors for the glyph and the description. An empty place is not an error; do not give it a status color. A failure to load is a callout with the error status.
Use live only where the empty state appears in answer to what the person just did (a search, a filter), so it is announced; one that is there when the page opens is not announced.
The title is text. Give a heading in the title slot where the empty state is the page's only content and the page needs one.
Use size large where the empty place is the whole page or the whole main region; medium inside a list, a table, a card, a panel, a search's results.
Center it in a region that is otherwise blank; align it to the start in a narrow column or under a table's header, where the content would have begun.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never draw a centred grey message by hand.

padding-block.$description: The room above the first part and below the last, per size: what keeps an empty region from collapsing onto its neighbours. A region that is taller places the empty state itself.

padding-inline.$description: The room at the start and the end: the inset a card, a callout and a list row give their content in the default system, so a start-aligned empty state begins where the rows would have.

measure.$description: The longest line of the title and of the description, as a multiple of the description's font size (ems): about 60 characters of Latin text, 30 of Japanese or Chinese. A short message in the middle of a wide table would otherwise run in one long line from edge to edge.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A count of characters, not a distance: it scales with the description's text size by being multiplied by it, and no dial moves it.

size.$description: The box of the glyph, per size. Medium is the largest step of the icon scale; large is half as large again, for an empty page. A picture of the product's own keeps its own size.

color.$description: The glyph's color: secondary content. Decorative: the title says what the glyph pictures.

gap.$description: The space between the glyph or the picture and the title.

typescale.$description: The title's text style, per size: at medium the heading role of the reading size, a step above the description by weight more than by size; at large a heading that can head a page.

color.$description: The title's color: the surface's text color. The one part of an empty state at full strength, so that it is what a reader sees first.

gap.$description: The space between the title and the description.

typescale.$description: The description's text style, per size: the interface's running text at medium, the style for reading at large.

color.$description: The description's color: secondary content, quieter than the title.

gap.$description: The space between the text and the row of actions.

item-gap.$description: The space between two actions, in the row and between rows when the actions wrap.
